## Improvements

- A new **agents:read** permission allows redacted configuration, skill, and instruction reads with no write authority, and scoped grants now work on individual configuration routes; every agent can read its own configuration ([#18766](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18766)). Agents hitting a board-only route get `code: "board_access_required"` with remediation that links the board page holding the control ([#20151](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/20151), [#20182](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/20182), [#20207](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/20207)).
- The agent page is regrouped into Agent and Audit sections with name and title editable in the header and Activity, Runs, Costs, and Budgets opening inside the agent ([#18378](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18378)); Identity files get a save footer ([#19535](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/19535)); the Secrets page shows the agent's environment bindings, masked ([#18121](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18121)); and AI connection choices show sign-in method, scope, and account so two accounts named "OpenAI" can be told apart ([#17738](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17738)).
- Routines show a **Responsible user** you can transfer or adopt; automatic tasks run as that person, and changes need `tasks:assign` or an instance admin ([#19128](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/19128)). An agent-owned task waiting only on a saved monitor shows a **Monitoring** status ([#18624](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18624)), shows **In Progress** only while a task-linked run is queued or running ([#19453](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/19453)), and a parent is woken once when a child stalls on a board-only recovery action ([#20098](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/20098)).
- The task feed groups adjacent images into a thumbnail grid ([#19626](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/19626)), shows agent-created subtasks as linked cards ([#18320](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18320)), renders `.patch`/`.diff` attachments with colors ([#19478](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/19478)), labels GitHub links as `owner/repo#123` ([#19476](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/19476)), and task documents open images in a shareable gallery ([#18157](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18157)). Retry shows its current recovery step ([#19260](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/19260)), and tool approval cards show server-redacted arguments ([#18734](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18734)).
- Faster tasks, chats, and inbox: cold task opens show the instruction and recent conversation first and load older history on demand ([#17593](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17593), [#18092](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18092), [#18461](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18461)); standing chats open on their 20 most recent messages and reopen from cache ([#18358](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18358), [#19452](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/19452)); Tasks and Inbox load a small index first ([#17756](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17756), [#18492](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18492)); and the Apps Permissions page no longer downloads every profile ([#18687](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18687)).
- More background work waits for committed writes and saved deadlines instead of polling the database — issue monitors and routines, automatic backups, native finalization and recovery, GitHub webhooks and the review bot, chat channels, tool health and reviews, approvals and join requests, plugin jobs, status cards, and agent timers ([#17863](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17863), [#17840](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17840), [#17836](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17836), [#17801](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17801), [#17666](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17666), [#17653](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17653), [#17554](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17554), [#17510](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17510), [#17518](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17518), [#18401](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18401), [#17876](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17876), [#18387](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18387)); recovery sweeps and UI polls read only the fields they need, for example about 2.5 MB down to under 2 KB per queued-comment poll ([#17650](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17650), [#17463](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17463), [#17460](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17460)).
- A public `GET`/`HEAD /api/ready` reports deployment readiness from memory and returns `503` with `Retry-After` while starting, recovering, or draining ([#18518](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18518)); the company issue list sets `X-Paperclip-Has-More` and next-page headers when capped ([#19972](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/19972)); `comment_on_task` gains an optional `resume` flag ([#20028](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/20028)); and the API catalog agents search through `call_api` gains bodies and guidance for company import/export and skill-source import ([#19945](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/19945), [#18757](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18757)).
- Agent observability exports native OpenCode turns, tool outcomes, and usage to Braintrust or OTLP ([#18098](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18098)); traces gain spans for Daytona lease acquisition, turn preparation, and skill preparation ([#18626](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18626), [#18213](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18213), [#17918](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17918)); and with `PAPERCLIP_SENTRY_RUN_FAILURES` on, task-level "Couldn't finish this attempt" failures are reported and a Codex capacity failure with a scheduled retry is not ([#18541](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18541), [#18295](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18295)).
- Daytona sandboxes gain an optional `ttlMinutes` wall-clock lifetime and gzip uploads on images without `zstd` ([#17980](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17980), [#20104](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/20104)); S3 multipart and workspace snapshot uploads run parts in parallel ([#18659](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18659), [#19917](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/19917)); Linux provider packs are smaller (linux-x64 from 1,131 MB to 876 MB) ([#17387](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17387)); and Grok Build agents get **Upgrade runner** on qualified hosts ([#17922](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17922)).
- Plugins can show task-sidebar panels driven by recorded runtime activity ([#18129](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18129), [#17796](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17796)), environment drivers can declare managed skills and require an agent ([#17774](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17774), [#17761](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17761)), a project writer can authorize a workspace-provider plugin to use their GitHub grant for repository maintenance ([#17798](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17798)), and workspace cleanup recognizes squash-merged GitHub PRs ([#18493](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18493)).
- The Paperclip Runner gains an experimental **Cursor Cloud** provider; the legacy Cursor Cloud adapter stays the default ([#18068](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18068), [#18069](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18069)).
- Model catalogs and sandbox CLI pins are refreshed — new OpenCode model IDs, Grok CLI 1.0.70, Gemini CLI 0.65.0, a newer Cursor CLI, and GitHub CLI 2.103.3 — and the environment Test names the Codex models retired for ChatGPT sign-in ([#17809](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17809)).
- The Connectors view marks your default personal AI account for each provider and changes it from a menu ([#19845](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/19845)); connector sign-in opens in its own window so you keep your place ([#18716](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18716)); and first-agent onboarding can connect a custom Responses or Messages AI gateway ([#17253](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17253)).
- Files and images can be dropped anywhere on the task page or the New task dialog ([#18849](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18849)); you can copy your own task messages as Markdown ([#19442](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/19442)); the skill slash menu shows skill descriptions ([#19502](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/19502)); task lists show assignee avatars ([#18607](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18607)); and agents ask independent questions together in one card ([#19634](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/19634)).
- A task created by a routine links back to it under Relationships, and routines link to a task list filtered by a new **Routine tasks** option ([#16471](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/16471), [#18317](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18317)).
- Adding the board to a phone home screen installs it as a standalone app without the address bar ([#13461](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13461)).
- A new read-only endpoint returns a line diff between an installed tracked-source skill and its pending upstream update ([#20155](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/20155)).

## Upgrade Guide

- **Migrations `0375`–`0451`** run on upgrade; none drops a table or column. Additive tables: `0394` `native_runner_checkpoints`; `0404` and `0433` per-user workspace preferences (Coordinator by default, `classic_workspace_enabled` off); `0405` interaction idempotency keys; `0415` and `0417` skill package storage, deletions, and mutation receipts; `0418` `sandbox_creation_operations`; `0421` and `0427` `execution_workspace_snapshots`; `0422` `agent_file_roots`; `0426` and `0428` project execution admissions (no route writes them yet); `0429` `native_harness_backups`; `0430` budget evaluation work; `0438` native provider artifacts; `0449` `controller_instances`; `0451` `budget_resume_claims`. Additive columns: `0379` project Git authorization, `0380` gateway token responsible user, `0396` inbound voice-call cleanup tracking (with a batched backfill), `0420`, `0424`, `0425`, `0431`, `0434` `issues.origin_issue_id`, `0439`, `0441`, `0442`, `0446`–`0448`. Triggers and functions: `0378` environment and plugin runtime hooks, `0444` GitHub refresh bookkeeping no longer advances agent runtimes. Row updates: `0376` and `0377` clear settled native recovery state and process identities; `0419` backfills Agent Chat read states; `0423` grants `agents:read`; `0443` clears stored per-turn lifecycles. Indexes: `0375` replaces the restore-point uniqueness index so stale pending restore points no longer block retries ([#17344](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17344)); the index-only migrations in `0381`–`0414`, `0432`, `0435`, `0436`, `0447`, and `0450` are built `CONCURRENTLY` outside a transaction and are safe to rerun if interrupted. `0437` and `0440` add structures self-hosted installs do not use and are harmless. Expect `0377`, `0395`, `0412`, `0414`, `0419`, and `0432` to take longer on instances with large run, activity, or comment histories; `0416` rebuilds a `heartbeat_runs` index inside a transaction and blocks writes to that table while it runs, `0445` likewise builds a `native_run_finalizations` index inside a transaction and blocks writes to that table while it runs, and `0434` briefly blocks `issues` writes.
- **New environment variables**, none required. Recovery: `PAPERCLIP_CONTROLLER_INSTANCE_LEASE` (on unless exactly `off`) — a server that loses its instance lease while holding work, for example because the database was unreachable for more than 60 seconds, logs a fatal error and exits with code 1 so a newer server can recover the work, so run Paperclip under a supervisor that restarts it ([#20054](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/20054)). Storage: `PAPERCLIP_SKILL_PACKAGE_STORAGE_ENABLED` (on unless exactly `false`) ([#18082](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18082)). Cleanup: `PAPERCLIP_NATIVE_WORKSPACE_SYNC_RETENTION_ENABLED` (on unless `false`) with `_DRY_RUN` (off unless `true`) and `_DAYS` (`7`) expires settled runs' native workspace sync folders ([#17358](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17358)); `PAPERCLIP_NATIVE_RUNNER_EVIDENCE_RETENTION_DAYS` (`7`) expires Runner continuity archives and quarantined sessions ([#17616](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17616)); `PAPERCLIP_TASK_DIRECTORY_RETENTION_ENABLED` (default `false`) with `_DRY_RUN` (on unless `false`) and `PAPERCLIP_TASK_DIRECTORY_ORPHAN_GRACE_DAYS` (`7`) saves finished plain task directories to restore points and removes them, and needs `PAPERCLIP_GIT_RESTORE_POINTS_ENABLED=true` ([#17472](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17472)); `PAPERCLIP_ISOLATED_SOURCE_REHOME_ENABLED` and `PAPERCLIP_NESTED_CLONE_MIGRATION_ENABLED` (default `false`, and unlike the other sweeps their `_DRY_RUN` switches are also off by default) move existing workspaces onto the shared clones, with rehome also requiring `PAPERCLIP_GIT_CACHE_EXPIRATION_ENABLED=true` ([#17369](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17369), [#17407](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17407)). Other: `BOXD_API_KEY` is the host fallback key for the boxd provider ([#17284](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17284)), and `PAPERCLIP_DB_RESPONSE_CAPTURE_WINDOW` opts into one bounded database response-size diagnostic window ([#17504](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17504)). An explicit `DATABASE_PREPARED_STATEMENTS=true` now also prepares ORM queries; behind a pooler without named-statement support, use `false` ([#17673](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/17673)).
- **Remote workspace storage is on by default where it applies** ([#18403](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18403)): with S3 storage, a `postgres://` `DATABASE_URL`, and a secrets master key, new task workspaces of Runner agents on sandbox environments enroll automatically. Every replacement server must use the same master key; snapshot expiry needs `s3:ListBucketVersions` and `s3:DeleteObjectVersion` on the snapshot prefix; and once a workspace is enrolled, do not roll back to an older binary. To opt out before upgrading, store `remoteWorkspaceStorageEnabled: false` in the experimental instance settings.
- **New and changed experimental settings**: `enableGoogleWorkspaceConnector` (default off, see Breaking Changes) ([#19247](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/19247)); `enableLegacyComposerSubmit` (default off) ([#19272](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/19272)); `remoteWorkspaceStorageEnabled` (default on); `enableAgentChat` is retired and Agent Chat is always on, ignoring a stored off value ([#19360](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/19360)); and **Artifacts V1** is on for every instance with its toggle removed ([#19164](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/19164)).
- **Default views change**: every person starts on the Coordinator workspace, and **Classic workspace** in Experimental settings brings back the previous layout ([#19360](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/19360)). The runner dropdown, including the "Legacy runner" override under Advanced, is removed from agent setup and configuration; new agents get the automatically selected runner, existing agents keep theirs, and the API and CLI still accept runner options ([#19517](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/19517)). New Codex agents default to `gpt-6.1-sol`; agents with a saved model keep it ([#19623](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/19623)). First-agent onboarding offers only Claude and Codex; other providers remain available when you add more agents ([#18309](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18309)).
- **Permissions** ([#18766](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18766)): migration `0423` grants company-wide `agents:read` to existing standard agents that are active and have an active membership, even where an operator had removed their configure grant; agents in setup, managed built-ins, low-trust or trust-boundary agents, and agents that already hold a scoped configure or suggest-changes grant are skipped. Each grant is logged as `agent.permissions_updated`; remove it from any agent that should not read peer configuration, and the removal persists. Separately, a CEO hiring denial is enforced only once it is saved on this release, so turn **Can create agents** off again on any CEO that should not hire ([#20041](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/20041)).
- **API clients**: native-run self status PATCH returns `409 native_run_status_reported_by_finish` ([#18411](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18411)); agent-created child tasks may return `parentAdjusted` ([#19312](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/19312)); `inheritExecutionWorkspaceFromIssueId` copies only project and strategy ([#19860](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/19860)); workspace detail responses no longer run Git and return delivery state `unknown`, so read close-readiness for Git safety ([#18410](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18410)); skill version lists omit file bodies ([#18082](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18082)); `GET /api/companies/{companyId}/user-directory` now returns each member's `membershipRole` to anyone with company access ([#15183](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/15183)); and new routes include `GET /api/issues/{id}/context-usage`, `POST /api/issues/{id}/context/compact`, `POST /api/agents/me/chat/messages`, `POST /api/issues/{id}/recovery-actions/confirm-owner-gone`, and the public `GET /api/ready`.
- **systemd users**: re-run `paperclipai service install` to pick up `KillMode=mixed`; existing unit files are not rewritten ([#18598](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18598)).
- **Telemetry**: when telemetry is enabled, `server.started` now carries only the OS family, and `connection.created`, `connection.updated`, and `connection.invoked` events carrying only the connector key and status are sent; `PAPERCLIP_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1` and `DO_NOT_TRACK=1` still turn telemetry off ([#18897](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18897)).
- **Harness pins** are unchanged from v2026.1106.0: Codex 0.160.0, Claude Agent SDK 0.3.286, OpenCode 1.18.34, and GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.88. Kimi Code ships at 2.3.3 ([#18028](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/18028)).
- No other configuration or API changes require action.

## Contributors

This release has 1,586 commits from 40 contributors. Thank you to everyone who contributed to this release!

@afurm, @AlexFrontegg, @ARTeMobAgents, @caniko, @clempat, @conreo, @d4kine, @Ethereal49, @fengwuqingchen, @genius-0963, @greegorij, @harjothkhara, @HviorForgeFlow, @jamiebuchanan, @LKL-ZREO, @lorenzozanee, @lyuboslavmedarov, @mdc2122, @MichielMAnalytics, @MindSyncHub, @MrBlackTongue, @naeemakhtar110, @phant0um, @Podwarden, @Rockiez, @stefanriegel, @sudheerDev, @tiangao88, @timafen, @xiehuanyi, @yzxcj797

name: v6.10.0
body:
Personal templates created through Create Template now live in a Git-ignored local library so repository updates never trip over personal registrations, the OpenAI image backend defaults to `gpt-image-2.6-sunburst`, Volcengine adds Seedream 5.0 with Ark as the default gateway, and a set of conversion, icon, notes, and Edit Native round-trip fixes resolves silent content loss and export aborts.

## Templates and repository updates

- Personal library workspaces and indexes now default to Git-ignored `skills/ppt-master/templates/local/<kind_dir>/` while official built-in templates stay read-only unless `--builtin` is passed to `register_template.py`. Confirm UI, chat discovery, `apply_template.py`, and `mirror_template_materialize.py` merge built-in and local layers in memory without mutating tracked files (`fd2f058d`, `7e0df670`).
- `update_repo.py` automatically migrates additive unstaged personal entries out of tracked `*_index.json` files into `templates/local/` before `git pull --ff-only`, so existing clones with registered custom templates update cleanly (`fd2f058d`).

## AI image generation

- The OpenAI backend defaults to `gpt-image-2.6-sunburst` across `image_gen.py`, `.env.example`, and documentation (`5495a5cb`).
- Volcengine supports `doubao-seedream-5-0-pro-260628` (new default) and `doubao-seedream-5-0-flash-260915` with per-model pixel-budget enforcement and defaults to the Ark endpoint while preserving existing LAS setups (#347, `3c6ffd0e`).
- Image output-path tests run inside temporary directories instead of touching `/out` (#351, `b243a950`).

## Edit Native PPTX, icons, notes, and source conversion

- **Edit Native PPTX**: newly authored block and inline Office Math (`a14:m`) on round-trip slides whose source XML never declared `xmlns:a14` now retain scoped MCE prefix bindings without causing false-positive conflicts on unrelated shape edits (#355 by @DoctrineAlanK, `05007015`).
- **Icons**: `tabler-outline` icons that combine stroke geometry with filled sub-elements (such as `percentage-50`, `discount`, and `accessible`) retain their filled details and resolve inline `style` stroke/fill overrides consistently in DrawingML (#354 by @kevindesuyo, `ea6b25da`).
- **Speaker notes**: narration lines starting with `#` followed immediately by digits or text (such as `#1 ...`) are no longer mistaken for page headings in `total_md_split.py` or stripped in exported PowerPoint speaker notes (#352 by @kevindesuyo, `1244d814`).
- **Source conversion (`source_to_md`)**: HTML pages declaring `iso-8859-1` / `latin1` aliases are decoded with the WHATWG `windows-1252` C1 mapping across both `doc_to_md.py` and `web_to_md.py` without affecting non-Latin-1 encodings or plain-text responses (#353 by @kevindesuyo, `98d47ea2`), and `web_to_md.py` writes forward-slash image links on Windows (#349 by @pranav-sirnapalli, `e2820d32`).

## Documentation

- Added the PPT Master wordmark/logo to both READMEs, updated recommended driving-model guidance to Kimi K3.1 and Gemini, and corrected the skill-only release ZIP size figure (`01fe5493`, `8b1c8131`, `00981ba3`, `3af3e8ef`, `14810331`, `d8ca696b`).

name: v1.30.0-pre
body:
This week's release includes reduced GPU usage across the app, a model picker for AI commit message generation in the Git Panel, a setting to hide the title bar, support for GPT-6.1 Terra, and faster scanning of large projects.

## Features

### AI

- Added support for GPT-6.1 Terra to the OpenAI provider. ([#66659](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66659); thanks [nymo](https://github.com/nymo))
- Added keyboard navigation to the agent thread switcher (opened with `ctrl-tab` from the Agent Panel or Threads Sidebar): `up` / `down`, `ctrl-n` / `ctrl-p`, and `home` / `end` move the selection, as do `ctrl-up` / `ctrl-down` while `ctrl` is still held. ([#66951](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66951); thanks [kinoute](https://github.com/kinoute))
- Added support for the Extra High thinking effort level for Gemini 4 Hydrogen (`gemini-4-hydrogen`), which now defaults to High. ([#67011](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/67011); thanks [LorenzoBiassio](https://github.com/LorenzoBiassio))
- Improved GitHub Copilot models to use their full context window when there is no long-context surcharge, and to display per-token pricing where available. ([#64302](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64302); thanks [Jozef833](https://github.com/Jozef833))
- Improved memory usage when saving long agent threads. ([#66683](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66683); thanks [founderinaction](https://github.com/founderinaction))

### Git

- Added a model picker to the Git Panel's commit editor for choosing the model used for commit message generation. The choice is saved to the `agent.commit_message_model` setting. ([#50674](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50674); thanks [soilSpoon](https://github.com/soilSpoon))

### Vim / Helix

- Added the `g r t` keybinding for `editor: go to type definition`, matching Neovim's default. ([#66759](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66759); thanks [ask4fusora](https://github.com/ask4fusora))
- Added the `] n` and `[ n` keybindings in visual mode for `vim: select next syntax node` and `vim: select previous syntax node`, matching Neovim's defaults. ([#66759](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66759); thanks [ask4fusora](https://github.com/ask4fusora))

### Languages

- Improved syntax highlighting of `#pragma` and `#undef` arguments in C and C++. ([#66875](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66875); thanks [imryanthedev](https://github.com/imryanthedev))

### Linux

- Improved ACP registry agent installation on musl-based Linux systems, such as Alpine, to use musl builds when available. ([#66914](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66914))

### Other

- Added a `title_bar.show` setting to hide the title bar always (`"never"`) or only in fullscreen (`"hide_in_full_screen"`). The default is `"always"`. ([#65671](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65671); thanks [wuemeli](https://github.com/wuemeli), and thanks [xipeng-jin](https://github.com/xipeng-jin) for an earlier implementation in [#42540](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42540))
- Added `editor: fold at current indentation level` to fold the whole document at the current line's indentation level. ([#66849](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66849))
- Added a `zed --debug-state` CLI flag that prints the running app's window, display, and platform state as JSON for debugging. ([#66852](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66852))
- Improved rendering efficiency to reduce GPU usage across the app, including when drawing paths (such as Git Graph lines), shadows, and content hidden behind other elements. ([#66806](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66806), [#66807](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66807), [#66809](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66809), [#66810](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66810), [#66811](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66811), [#66812](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66812))
- Improved battery life by animating spinners without re-rendering the views that contain them. ([#66896](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66896))
- Improved responsiveness during heavy filesystem activity, such as external builds creating or removing many files. ([#66835](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66835), [#66973](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66973), [#66990](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66990), [#67008](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/67008); thanks [RemcoSmitsDev](https://github.com/RemcoSmitsDev))
- Improved the time to scan large projects when they are opened. ([#67023](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/67023); thanks [ptweezy](https://github.com/ptweezy))
- Improved fuzzy matching performance when many candidates match. ([#66982](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66982); thanks [ptweezy](https://github.com/ptweezy))
- Improved performance of multibuffers with many files, such as large project search results. ([#67053](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/67053); thanks [ptweezy](https://github.com/ptweezy))
- Improved performance when large directories are removed or rescanned. ([#66962](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66962); thanks [ptweezy](https://github.com/ptweezy))
- Improved responsiveness of the completions menu with many matches. ([#66959](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66959); thanks [ptweezy](https://github.com/ptweezy))
- Improved the onboarding page to keep the "Finish Setup" button visible while scrolling. ([#67079](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/67079); thanks [aakashbapna](https://github.com/aakashbapna))
- Improved the time to share or remotely open projects with very many files. ([#66961](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66961); thanks [ptweezy](https://github.com/ptweezy))
- Improved the which-key popup to also show inside open dialogs, like Go to Line and the commit editor. ([#66838](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66838))

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed a bug on Windows and Linux where opening a file or folder while Zed was closed did not restore the last session, losing previously open windows, tabs, and unsaved buffers. ([#65463](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65463); thanks [Verlaire](https://github.com/Verlaire))
- Fixed a bug where the worktree trust modal reappeared every time a project was opened after choosing "Stay in Restricted Mode". ([#66649](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66649))
- Fixed a bug where typing in an agent thread lost keyboard focus when another thread automatically sent its queued message. ([#66787](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66787); thanks [daejey](https://github.com/daejey))
- Fixed a crash when clicking or selecting text in agent messages and other rendered Markdown containing non-ASCII characters. ([#67104](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/67104))
- Fixed `always_confirm` patterns for the agent's `edit_file` and `write_file` tools (`agent.tool_permissions.tools.<tool>.always_confirm`) not prompting for files inside the project. ([#67037](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/67037))
- Fixed crashes on Windows when the display containing Zed's window changed. ([#66855](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66855))
- Fixed Helix mode ignoring the `vim.use_system_clipboard` setting. Yank, delete, and paste in Helix mode use the system clipboard by default again, as they did before 1.28. To keep the 1.28 behavior of using the internal register, set `"vim": { "use_system_clipboard": "never" }`. ([#66906](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66906); thanks [sandr01d](https://github.com/sandr01d))
- Fixed new windows always opening on the primary display instead of the display of the active window. ([#61459](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/61459); thanks [errmayank](https://github.com/errmayank))
- Fixed Vim's `:s` without the `g` flag replacing the wrong matches when used after the first line. ([#67015](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/67015); thanks [ptweezy](https://github.com/ptweezy))
- Fixed a bug where a file's branch diff stayed broken until Zed was restarted if it failed to load once. ([#67116](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/67116); thanks [ptweezy](https://github.com/ptweezy))
- Fixed a bug where a project folder containing entries named `HEAD` and `config` (such as `head` and `config` source directories on case-insensitive filesystems) was detected as a bare Git repository, causing the Git Panel to switch to a bogus repository and show a "detected dubious ownership" message. ([#67024](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/67024); thanks [likeaixxx](https://github.com/likeaixxx))
- Fixed a bug where clicking a tool call's file label or "Go to File" button in an agent thread did nothing for image files. ([#67092](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/67092); thanks [daejey](https://github.com/daejey))
- Fixed a bug where clicking one command in the agent's permission dropdown for chained terminal commands checked every command in the chain. ([#56492](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/56492); thanks [tredondo](https://github.com/tredondo))
- Fixed a bug where `task: rerun` opened the task spawn menu instead of rerunning the last task after any edit to `tasks.json`. ([#66646](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66646))
- Fixed a bug where terminals closed from the tab switcher stayed in its list until the switcher was reopened. ([#66943](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66943); thanks [csarushan1729](https://github.com/csarushan1729))
- Fixed a bug where the Agent Panel's Follow toggle turned itself back on after being disabled. ([#63467](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/63467); thanks [gumeeee](https://github.com/gumeeee))
- Fixed a bug where the agent's grep tool silently ignored misnamed parameters from some smaller models and searched the whole project instead of a specific file or folder. ([#66586](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66586); thanks [AbyssWaIker](https://github.com/AbyssWaIker))
- Fixed a bug where the fading of unused code could extend past the unused code. ([#66977](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66977); thanks [ptweezy](https://github.com/ptweezy))
- Fixed a bug where Vue prop completions were missing when typing lowercase letters with Emmet enabled. ([#66936](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66936); thanks [GSGFs7](https://github.com/GSGFs7))
- Fixed a crash that could occur after moving a project with an open split diff to a new window. ([#67128](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/67128); thanks [Stiven-Gjekaj](https://github.com/Stiven-Gjekaj))
- Fixed an empty strip appearing at the bottom of the commit modal. ([#67090](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/67090); thanks [keantx](https://github.com/keantx))
- Fixed duplicate language server notifications appearing when switching themes. ([#67021](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/67021); thanks [xsadia](https://github.com/xsadia))
- Fixed Git blame failing with a broken pipe error for large untracked files. ([#67110](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/67110); thanks [dmytrodanilenkov](https://github.com/dmytrodanilenkov))
- Fixed incorrect R extension installation suggestions for Quarto and R Markdown files. ([#66928](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66928))
- Fixed LM Studio and llama.cpp model discovery requests being sent at startup when `disable_ai` is `true`. ([#66842](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66842); thanks [Pixelrick420](https://github.com/Pixelrick420))
- Fixed `log` settings keyed by module path (such as `project::lsp_store`) not enabling `debug` or `trace` logs. ([#66985](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66985); thanks [ptweezy](https://github.com/ptweezy))
- Fixed Mermaid diagrams in the Markdown preview having state descriptions that overlapped the state title, sequence diagram titles that were cut off, and labels that overflowed their nodes with wide fonts. ([#66874](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66874))
- Fixed multiple cursors overwriting the primary selection with newlines on Linux. ([#66986](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66986); thanks [ptweezy](https://github.com/ptweezy))
- Fixed prompt caching not being used for OpenRouter's Anthropic model aliases (e.g. `~anthropic/claude-sonnet-latest`). ([#66857](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66857); thanks [Kioob](https://github.com/Kioob))
- Fixed recent projects displaying incorrectly for Windows remote projects when running Zed on macOS or Linux. ([#66465](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66465); thanks [lingyaochu](https://github.com/lingyaochu))
- Fixed `ssh://` links with a drive letter (for example `ssh://user@host/C:/project`) failing to open a project on a Windows remote. ([#66814](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66814); thanks [h4nz4](https://github.com/h4nz4))
- Fixed syntax highlighting sometimes going missing after Vim method, section, and comment motions. ([#66983](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66983); thanks [ptweezy](https://github.com/ptweezy))
- Fixed the agent's `read_file` tool failing when models pass `start_line` or `end_line` as strings. ([#67072](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/67072); thanks [ChromaxS](https://github.com/ChromaxS))
- Fixed the Project Panel showing a leading or trailing whitespace warning instead of an empty-name error when a file or directory name contained only whitespace. ([#67125](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/67125); thanks [ptweezy](https://github.com/ptweezy))
- (Preview only) Fixed files in the commit view briefly appearing expanded before collapsing when `git.commit_view.expand_files` is disabled. ([#67111](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/67111); thanks [mmatczuk](https://github.com/mmatczuk) for an earlier implementation in [#66754](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66754))

## Breaking Changes and Notices

- Changed the default value of `file_finder.prefill_query_from_selection` from `true` to `false`, so the file finder no longer pre-fills its query with the selected text. To return to the previous behavior, set it to `true`. ([#66856](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66856))

name: v1.29.1
body:
This week's release includes a Git Panel branch mode that lists every file changed since a base branch, a bookmark picker, configurable Git date formats, support for Claude Fable 5.2 for Anthropic BYOK users (plus Claude Mythos 5.2 if your organization has access), and a setting to turn off automatic agent thread titles.

## Features

### AI

- Added an `agent.auto_generate_thread_titles` setting (default `true`) that can be set to `false` to disable automatic title generation for Zed Agent threads. ([#63998](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/63998); thanks [FrederickGeek8](https://github.com/FrederickGeek8))
- Added support for Claude Fable 5.2 for Anthropic BYOK users, plus Claude Mythos 5.2 if your organization has access. ([#66760](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66760))
- Improved the copy button on agent responses to briefly show a checkmark confirming the copy. ([#64664](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64664); thanks [itsfuad](https://github.com/itsfuad))
- Improved the ordering of ACP agent config options in the message editor so the first option the agent provides appears next to the send button. ([#66733](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66733))

### Git

- Added a branch mode to the Git Panel that lists all files changed since a base branch, such as `origin/main`. Choose "Compare Against Base" from the new menu at the top of the Changes tab to pick the base branch, or run `git panel: show branch changes` to compare against the default branch. Files in this mode can be opened as diffs but not staged or restored. ([#66482](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66482))
- Added a `git.date_format` setting (`"locale"`, `"iso"`, or a strftime format such as `"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"`) for absolute Git dates, and `date_style` settings (`"relative"` or `"absolute"`) to choose how dates are shown in each view: `git.blame.date_style`, `git.inline_blame.date_style`, `git.branch_picker.date_style`, `git.stash_picker.date_style`, `git_panel.date_style`, and `git_graph.date_style`. ([#66533](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66533); thanks [scarf005](https://github.com/scarf005))
- Added `git.commit_view.expand_description` and `git.commit_view.expand_files` settings to control whether the commit view opens with the full commit message shown and the changed files expanded. ([#66331](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66331); thanks [mmatczuk](https://github.com/mmatczuk))
- Improved opening a commit from Git blame to scroll the commit view to the blamed file instead of the top of the diff. ([#65237](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65237); thanks [seongheum-choi](https://github.com/seongheum-choi))
- Improved Git status refresh performance in very large repositories when many files change at once. ([#66242](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66242); thanks [ambyjkl](https://github.com/ambyjkl))
- Improved `git: rename branch` to trim the new branch name and replace spaces with dashes, matching branch creation, and to preview the resulting name in the rename modal. ([#65734](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65734); thanks [Sha1rholder](https://github.com/Sha1rholder))
- Improved the Git Panel's repository selector to distinguish repositories that share the same directory name. ([#62800](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/62800); thanks [BirknerAlex](https://github.com/BirknerAlex))

### Other

- Added a bookmark picker for browsing, searching, and previewing all bookmarks in the current workspace, opened with `project bookmarks: toggle`. ([#60005](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/60005); thanks [guopenghui](https://github.com/guopenghui))
- Improved `dev: open key context view` by adding horizontal scrolling, so long context predicates are no longer cut off. ([#66528](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66528))

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed a bug where opening a file through the Open dialog (`workspace: open`) replaced the current project with one containing only that file instead of opening it as a tab in the current project. ([#66103](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66103))
- Fixed a bug where switching branches in a remote project resent the full Git history over SSH, stalling the terminal and file opening until the transfer finished. ([#65436](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65436); thanks [azeemshaik025](https://github.com/azeemshaik025))
- Fixed the file finder not showing files outside the project when searching by absolute path, and files matching `file_scan_exclusions` when searching by their exact path. ([#66227](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66227))
- Fixed a bug where the copy button at the bottom of an agent thread could copy a response from an earlier turn when the latest turn had no response text. ([#64664](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64664); thanks [itsfuad](https://github.com/itsfuad))
- Fixed a bug where the read-only toggle icon and action were shown on tabs that do not support toggling read-only. ([#66650](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66650))
- Fixed a crash when moving a project with a split diff to a new window. ([#67128](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/67128); thanks [Stiven-Gjekaj](https://github.com/Stiven-Gjekaj))
- Fixed an empty strip at the bottom of the commit modal. ([#67090](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/67090); thanks [keantx](https://github.com/keantx))
- Fixed animated WebP files only displaying their first frame when opened in the image viewer. ([#66459](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66459); thanks [jorge1b3](https://github.com/jorge1b3))
- Fixed bold text using the wrong theme colors in Markdown previews. ([#63940](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/63940); thanks [IbrahimKhan12](https://github.com/IbrahimKhan12))
- Fixed `cmd-o` opening the file dialog instead of project symbol search when using the JetBrains keymap on macOS. ([#66137](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66137); thanks [dmytrodanilenkov](https://github.com/dmytrodanilenkov))
- Fixed combining marks such as `v̄` rendering to the right of their base glyph on Linux. ([#66799](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66799); thanks [ItsGlucose](https://github.com/ItsGlucose))
- Fixed commit messages losing their line breaks in the commit view. ([#66608](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66608); thanks [mmatczuk](https://github.com/mmatczuk))
- Fixed `cmd-k` (macOS) and `ctrl-k` (Linux/Windows) in the JetBrains keymap not focusing the commit message, including when the Git Panel was closed or showing its History tab. Pressing the key again no longer returns focus to the editor; use `cmd-0` (macOS) or `alt-0` (Linux/Windows) to toggle Git Panel focus. ([#66330](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66330); thanks [mmatczuk](https://github.com/mmatczuk))
- Fixed entry icons overlapping diff stats in a narrow Git Panel. ([#66278](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66278); thanks [lingyaochu](https://github.com/lingyaochu))
- Fixed extension snippets being duplicated each time an extension is reloaded. ([#66798](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66798); thanks [IbrahimKhan12](https://github.com/IbrahimKhan12))
- Fixed LM Studio and llama.cpp model discovery requests being sent at startup despite `disable_ai` being true. ([#66842](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66842); thanks [Pixelrick420](https://github.com/Pixelrick420))
- Fixed terminal links to absolute paths outside the project not opening when the remote's OS differs from the local one (e.g. WSL on Windows). ([#66594](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66594); thanks [brunocordioli072](https://github.com/brunocordioli072))
- Fixed the end of the Markdown preview being cut off when the file starts with a blank line or an HTML comment. ([#66467](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66467); thanks [yyq1025](https://github.com/yyq1025))
- Fixed the Threads Sidebar not showing a waiting indicator for threads with unanswered agent input forms. ([#66708](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66708); thanks [daejey](https://github.com/daejey))
- Fixed the `zed` CLI rejecting multiple `ssh://` paths on the same host in a single command. ([#66568](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66568); thanks [kawadeomkar](https://github.com/kawadeomkar))
- Fixed Vim `:s` and `:%s` commands not recognizing `\+` and `\{n\}` repetition operators in search patterns. ([#66515](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66515); thanks [akramcodez](https://github.com/akramcodez))
- Fixed Vim's `:s` without the `g` flag replacing the wrong matches when used after the first line. ([#67015](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/67015); thanks [ptweezy](https://github.com/ptweezy))
- Fixed which-key closing the commit editor and pickers when a multi-key binding was pending. ([#66630](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66630); thanks [divyanshus2404](https://github.com/divyanshus2404))
- Fixed worktree index corruption when excluding symlinks that point inside a project. ([#64818](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64818); thanks [porada](https://github.com/porada))
- Fixed `zed --add --diff` adding the working directory as a project folder in the focused window. ([#66386](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66386); thanks [abdelq](https://github.com/abdelq))
- Fixed `zed --add` choosing the wrong window or project when several open projects matched equally or none matched, now preferring the focused window and its active project. ([#66386](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66386); thanks [abdelq](https://github.com/abdelq))
- Fixed `Zed.exe path:line` being ignored on Windows when Zed is already running. ([#66501](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66501); thanks [h4nz4](https://github.com/h4nz4))
- Fixed `zed://file` and `file://` links with a drive letter (for example `zed://file/C:/project/main.rs:12`) opening an empty window on Windows. ([#66497](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66497); thanks [h4nz4](https://github.com/h4nz4))

## Breaking Changes and Notices

- Fixed Helix mode ignoring the `vim.use_system_clipboard` setting. Yank, delete and paste in Helix mode use the system clipboard by default again, as they did before 1.28. If you wish to keep the 1.28 behavior, set `"vim": { "use_system_clipboard": "never" }` to keep using the internal register. ([#66906](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66906); thanks [sandr01d](https://github.com/sandr01d))

name: v5.1.79
body:
### Fixed

- The `/remote` close in the TUI follows `thread_close`'s close contract (#14234). A close refused because the thread has messages it has not read names `/remote close <session> --force` and lists those messages, or says the ids are unavailable on that device's engine. The picker then offers "Close anyway". A forced close lists the messages it dropped. The refusal's `details.reason` is the engine's own reason (`turn_active` or `work_pending`). ([#14246](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14246), fixes [#14245](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/14245)) ([#14248](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14248))
- Thread tools: a command for a thread whose session parked on another device after it was listed no longer fails `unsupported` with advice to update omo on that device. The device service answers such a command `route_unlisted` (its host no longer lists that session, so nothing was sent to it). `thread_close` now answers `closed: false, reason: "not_live"`, and the other thread tools answer `not_resumable`, as for a session that ended there. A create, or a reopen's session-file lookup, refused that way is `host_unavailable`, with a retry. ([#14237](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14237), fixes [#14233](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/14233)) ([#14248](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14248))
- The cold-wake session host unit (and every other unit or plist the cold-wake install writes) is now written 0644 under any umask. Under umask 077 it was written 0600, because a file's creation mode is masked by the umask; the mode is now set explicitly before the file is moved into place. ([#14249](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14249), fixes [#14247](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/14247)) ([#14248](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14248))
- A cold-wake unit or plist an earlier build already left 0600 is set back to 0644 the next time the install (or a refresh to a newer runtime) finds its content unchanged, with no reload or restart. A file this user cannot change the mode of (another owner's, or on a read-only filesystem) is left as it is and the install still succeeds. ([#14249](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14249)) ([#14248](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14248))

### Changed

- **`thread_close` no longer drops messages a thread has not read unless you ask it to.** Before, it always interrupted the session and silently dropped any messages queued behind its run. Now:
  - A busy thread with unread messages is refused `turn_active`. The refusal names those messages (`pending_deliveries`) and gives the `force` option.
  - `thread_close({ thread, force: true })` closes it anyway.
  - Every close result carries `dropped_deliveries`, the messages it handed back unread (an empty list when there were none).
  - An idle thread still closes without `force`, even when an interrupted run left messages stranded (#14169); those are listed too.
  - On a device whose engine cannot name its queued messages (older than code-yeongyu/senpi#7006), a default close never interrupts. It says the message ids are unavailable there, and `force: true` still closes it.
  - `omo remote close` takes `--force` and reports the dropped messages as well. ([#14242](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14242), fixes [#14234](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/14234)) ([#14248](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14248))

### Added

- The desktop can ask OmO which model each category and agent runs. A new read-only extension request, `omo.modelRouting.resolve`, answers the model every category (under its canonical name) and every task agent would spawn on, using the same resolvers a `task` call uses against the session's project config, model registry and sign-ins, and says whether that model came from your omo.json or from OmO's defaults. ([#14025](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14025))
